description: This file defines a class for integrating Supabase as a vector store within a larger system, including methods for upserting and deleting vectors, initializing the store, and handling related configurations. It also exports the class for external use.

classes.name: Supabase_VectorStores
classes.description: Class implementing a node for Supabase vector store integration, supporting upsert, delete, and initialization functionalities.

classes.name: SupabaseUpsertVectorStore
classes.description: Extends SupabaseVectorStore with additional method for batch adding vectors with upsert logic.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods
methods.description: Contains methods for upserting and deleting vectors in the Supabase vector store.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the vector store with provided parameters and filters.

methods.name: addVectors
methods.description: Adds vectors and associated documents to the store, handling batch upsert and ID generation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes vectors from the store based on provided IDs, with support for record management.
